title: 人物与事件名词辨析
goal: 根据事件所指辨析同类名词。

points.label: 确定空格名词所指的事件或事物
区分同类名词的语境意义

body.p: 名词可以概括前文的目标、行动或结果。判断所指时，先核对事件，再比较名词的意义。

body.box: Their goal was to prepare a meal. Her task was to wash the vegetables.

body.p: goal 指希望达到的目标，task 指承担的具体任务。两者都与准备饭菜有关，所指不同。

cards.title: 词汇表：目标任务
rows: Their goal was a clean room. Her task was to sweep the floor.
The aim was to save water. His duty was to close the tap.
The plan covered three steps. The first step was to measure the table.
The purpose was to share books. Her responsibility was to label them.

cards.title: 词汇表：困难机会
rows: The visit was a chance to learn. The choice was between two routes.
The leak was a problem. A new pipe was the solution.
The distance was a difficulty. The visit was an opportunity to meet the guide.
The fallen tree was an obstacle. The side path was an option.

cards.title: 词汇表：帮助支持
rows: She did him a favor by carrying the box. Her support continued throughout his course.
His help made the work easier. His advice was to begin early.
With her assistance, he moved the shelf. Her guidance showed him how to use the tools.
Her encouragement gave him confidence. Their cooperation made the project possible.

cards.title: 词汇表：结果评价
rows: The result was a dry floor. The reward for his work was a book.
The outcome was a repaired chair. The prize was a notebook.
Finishing the bridge was a success. Each repair showed progress.
The first attempt was a failure. The completed bridge was an achievement.

items.stem: The class wanted to raise funds. This overall ___ guided the project.
items.why: wanted to raise funds 指整个项目希望达到的目标。

items.stem: Mia could choose the morning or afternoon shift. Her ___ was between two times.
items.why: between two times 表示在两个时间之间作出的选择。

items.stem: The neighbor carried the parcel upstairs for Ken as a single helpful act. Ken thanked her for the ___.
items.why: carried the parcel 是一次具体的帮忙，即 favor。

items.stem: As a gift for winning, Lea received a notebook. The notebook was her ___.
items.why: gift for winning 指获胜得到的回报。

items.stem: The group needed to clean the room. Amir's assigned job was to sweep. Sweeping was his ___.
items.why: assigned job 指分派给 Amir 的具体任务。

items.stem: The visit gave Ana an opportunity to meet the author. It was a ___ to learn from her.
items.why: opportunity 对应 chance，表示学习的机会。

items.stem: Water entered through the roof. The ___ was the leak in the roof.
items.why: Water entered through the roof 说明屋顶漏水，漏水是需要解决的问题。

items.stem: The floor became dry after the leak was repaired. A dry floor was the ___ of the repair.
items.why: 修理之后地板变干，是修理的结果。

items.stem: The coach kept helping Nia throughout her training. She valued his continuing ___.
items.why: kept helping throughout her training 指持续的支持。

items.stem: The first attempt did not work, but the second did. The first was a ___.
items.why: did not work 说明第一次尝试失败。

items.stem: Jin told Omar to start early. This suggestion was her ___.
items.why: told Omar to start early 是一条建议。

items.stem: The fallen branch blocked the path. It was an ___ on the route.
items.why: blocked the path 说明树枝是障碍。

groups.fill: Our class organized a book exchange. Our go{al} was to share books, and my ta{sk} was to label the shelves. The pl{an} listed each step. We had a cho{ice} between two rooms, and the library offered a cha{nce} to meet more readers. A volunteer gave us he{lp} with the shelves. Her continuing sup{port} kept the project going. She also did us a fa{vor} by carrying a box. The res{ult} was a busy exchange; our rew{ard} was seeing the books find new readers.

items.stem: The team's overall aim was to build a bench. Its ___ was to build a bench.
items.why: overall aim 指整体目标，即 goal。

items.stem: Nora had to decide whether to use paint or paper. This ___ was between two materials.
items.why: decide whether 表示在两种材料之间作出选择。

items.stem: A neighbor carried one parcel upstairs for Eli. Eli thanked her for that particular ___.
items.why: carried one parcel 是具体的一次帮忙。

items.stem: After the leak was repaired, the floor stayed dry. The dry floor was the ___ of the repair.
items.why: 修理后地板保持干燥，是这一行动的结果。

items.stem: The visit made it possible for Zoe to learn from the baker. It gave her a ___ to learn.
items.why: made it possible 指提供了学习机会。

items.stem: The winner received a book for her work. The book was her ___.
items.why: received a book for her work 指得到的回报。
